flawless: A knight of Benalia does not tire, and today he did not even bleed.
Your attack was honest, if not wise. Rise, and learn.
I arrived in the nick of time, as always. You never touched me.
solid: You struck true more than once. Benalia honours a worthy foe.
My armour wears your marks now, and I'll wear them proudly.
close: Saints of Benalia! One more blow and they'd have carried me home on my shield.
I have jousted with champions and never come so near the dust. Well met.
